## Acknowledgments

The development of ggseg has been supported by the following funding sources:

### EU Horizon 2020

[**Lifebrain**](https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/732592) - Healthy minds 0-100 years: Optimizing the use of European brain imaging cohorts (Grant 732592)

### European Research Council

**Starting Grants**

- [Grant 283634](https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/283634) (Anders Martin Fjell)
- [Grant 313440](https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/313440) (Kristine Beate Walhovd)

**Consolidator Grants**

- [Grant 771355](https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/771355) (Kristine Beate Walhovd)
- [Grant 725025](https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/725025) (Anders Martin Fjell)

### Norwegian Research Council

The project has received funding through multiple grants from the Norwegian Research Council.

## How to Acknowledge ggseg

If you use ggseg in your research, please cite:

```bibtex
@article{mowinckel2020,
  title={Visualization of Brain Statistics with R Packages ggseg and ggseg3d},
  author={Mowinckel, Athanasia M and Vidal-Pi{\~n}eiro, Didac},
  journal={Advances in Methods and Practices in Psychological Science},
  volume={3},
  number={4},
  pages={466--483},
  year={2020},
  publisher={SAGE Publications}
}
```
